title: Learn AI Search Engine Optimization | AI Ranking
description: Join 7.4k+ business owners, agencies and freelancers learning AI search engine optimization. Get the tools, skills and live coaching to win traffic from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI.

passages.text: It's an online community for business owners, agency owners and freelancers. Learn the basics for free, upgrade when live coaching and 1:1 help are worth it.
Ignore the alphabet soup. We teach you what actually moves the needle, and keep you current as the buzzwords keep changing.

AI Ranking is a community and course that teaches business owners, agency owners and freelancers how to get cited and recommended by AI search, not just ranked on Google. You'll learn the SEO foundations AI engines reward, plus the GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) tactics that get ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews to quote you as the answer.
Built for the people doing the work: business owners, freelancers and agency owners. Everything is taught step by step in plain language, and updated every week as the engines change.
Take a breath. None of this means you are behind. It means the rules changed, and they can be learned. Here is the shift, in sixty seconds.
For 25 years you climbed a page of ten blue links to earn a click. Now AI answers the question outright and names one business. You either are the recommendation, or you are invisible.
You do not need to chase every update. You need the handful of fundamentals that make AI trust and name your business. Start here.
Nico has spent more than 10 years in SEO. This is a member's Google Search Console: clicks and impressions climbing month after month, using the exact system you'll learn inside.

Hi, I'm Nico Gorrono. For over a decade I've been obsessed with one thing: getting websites found. I started as a digital marketer, head down in search engines and analytics, learning what actually moves rankings versus what just sounds good in a pitch deck.

Then everything changed. During the crypto crash I stumbled onto GPT-3 and saw what was coming. AI wasn't a gimmick, it was a way to do real SEO work faster and better than the agencies charging thousands a month. I started using it to automate the grind, rank my own sites, and build a real digital marketing agency around it.

Here's the part that bugged me. Business owners and freelancers were getting locked out. SEO had become this expensive, gatekept thing where you either paid an agency a fortune or stayed invisible. Meanwhile the tools to do it yourself were finally within reach, if someone would just show you how. Nobody was.

So I built AI Ranking: a supportive space where anyone, at any experience level, can master AI-driven SEO and rank #1 without handing it all to an expensive agency. Two live Q&As every week, a 1:1 call with every premium member, and the exact methods I use on my own sites. No theory for the sake of theory. Just what works, updated every week as Google keeps changing.
Buyers ask AI before they ask Google. If you're only optimising for blue links, you're invisible where the decision actually happens.
Scroll through what your membership unlocks. Built to take you from first citation to ranking #1 across every AI engine.
Members get DataWise, our AI-powered SEO command center. Keyword research, rank tracking, site audits and competitor analysis live in one dashboard built to get you cited.
There's a free community to learn the basics and a paid community to go all in. No card required to start, and no pressure to upgrade until it's worth it.

SEO gets you ranked in traditional search. GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) gets you cited inside AI answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Claude. We teach both, because strong SEO fundamentals are what AI engines reward first.

No. The community is built for business owners, agency owners and freelancers. We give you step-by-step playbooks, templates and done-for-you automations. You bring your business, we bring the system.
Members typically see their first AI citation within 48 hours of applying the fundamentals, and reach top-rank for their category within roughly 90 days. Your pace depends on how quickly you ship.
Yes, there's a free community to get started with weekly GEO tips and a starter playbook. Upgrade any time for premium tutorials, automations and live support.
Not sure if AI Ranking is right for your business? Send us your question and we'll get back to you personally... or my bot will, but directed by me... I swear.
